description: Read the user's local AI coding usage (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and the other tools ccusage supports) by running ccusage@20 on this machine. Returns a summary: API-equivalent cost in USD, tokens, days tracked, date range and cost per tool. Sends nothing anywhere. Can take a minute on a long history; results are cached for 5 minutes.

force_refresh.description: Re-run ccusage instead of using the 5-minute cache.

name: get_usage
